patch_description: Insert a mid-circuit parity-shared rotation layer between the entanglement and phase layers in ANSATZ_SPEC. This allows the circuit to refine feature representations after entanglement using tightly-shared rotations (even/odd qubits share parameters), which boosts expressivity per parameter while improving margin separation on hard samples. The new layer adds only 2 distinct parameters (ry_mid_even/odd and rz_mid_even/odd collapse to 2 unique names), enabling better robust separation without parameter count explosion. Prior seeds showed this architecture tightens worst-group margins significantly.
